1.w: My son, keep my words and treasure my commands within you.

2.w: Guard my commands and live, and my instruction like the pupil of your eyes.

3.w: Bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.

4.w: Say to wisdom, “You [are] my sister,” and call out to understanding, “Kinsman,”

5.w: to guard you from the strange woman, from a foreign woman [who] has made smooth her words.

6.w: For at the window of my house I have looked through my lattice,

7.w: and I have looked among the simple, [and] discerned among the sons a young man lacking heart,

8.w: passing by on the street near her corner, and the way of her house he steps in—

9.w: in the twilight, in the evening [of] the day, in the pupil of night and darkness.

10.w: And behold, a woman to meet him, [in] the garment of a prostitute and guarded of heart.

11.w: She [is] roaring and rebellious; in her house her feet do not dwell.

12.w: Once in the street, once in the open squares, and beside every corner she lies in wait.

13.w: And she laid hold on him and kissed him; she has hardened her face and said to him:

14.w: “Sacrifices of peace offerings [are] by me; this day I have paid my vows;

15.w: upon thus I have come out to meet you, to earnestly seek your face, and I have found you!

16.w: With coverings I have spread my couch, [with] colored linen of Egypt.

17.w: I have sprinkled my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

18.w: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning; let us delight ourselves with loves!

19.w: For the husband is not in his house; he has gone far away on a road.

20.w: A bag of silver he has taken with him; on the day of the full moon he will enter his house.”

21.w: She turns him aside with the abundance of her speech; with the smoothness of her lips she compels him.

22.w: Going after her suddenly, he goes in like an ox to the slaughter, like a deer bounding into a trap,

23.w: until an arrow splits his liver, like the hurrying of a bird to the snare, and he did not know that it [was] for his soul!

24.w: And now, sons, listen to me, and attend to the words of my mouth.

25.w: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways, do not stray into her paths.

26.w: For many wounded ones she has made fall; and numerous [are] all her slain ones.

27.w: Her house [is] the way to Sheol, going down to the chambers of death.
